caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: The Gemalto FIPS Object Module is a hardened version of the general purpose OpenSSL FIPS Object module designed to provide FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic functionality.
